title: Live GitHub barrier-backed PIN race · 5 workers v2
mission: Run a fresh real-GitHub five-worker contention canary on a clean fixed G000001 generation using the now-CI-guarded timing-only contention barrier. Five genuinely distinct /wc workers must register before the barrier deadline; a no-authority RELEASE then sends all released entrants to the exact same deterministic G000001 portfolio PIN. Exactly one PIN/claim winner and four genuine loser collision receipts must result. Never manufacture entrants/collisions, never create G000002+ for this fixture, and do not promote production /w or product authority.
definition_of_done: Five distinct /wc worker_ids have append-only entrant receipts under the declared v2 barrier before deadline.
Exactly one RELEASE.json exists, lists at least those five distinct entrants, states grants_execution_authority=false and next_action=RACE_DETERMINISTIC_PIN.
No portfolio PIN attempt exists before valid RELEASE; timeout instead records pin_attempted=false and remains a non-pass bounded outcome.
After RELEASE exactly one valid G000001 portfolio PIN winner and one matching authoritative claim exist for this job.
Exactly four distinct generation-1 prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 loser receipts exist; no loser creates an authoritative execution claim and each records next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION.
The fixed-generation recovery policy keeps the fixture out of ordinary G+1 recovery and resolves fixed_generation_attention only when the four-collision acceptance threshold is durably satisfied.
Live/allocator evidence remains canary-only and no Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
